notes.title: 🎉 Out Now: Sugardew Island Kickstarter
notes.notes:
[h3]The wait is over! [/h3]
🥳Sugardew Island has officially launched on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rokaplay/sugardew-island-your-cozy-farm-shop?ref=5l8hb3]Kickstarter.[/url] Don't miss your chance to be part of this heartwarming adventure from the very start. Join us now on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rokaplay/sugardew-island-your-cozy-farm-shop?ref=5l8hb3]Kickstarter[/url] and dive into the unique world of Sugardew Island.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rokaplay/sugardew-island-your-cozy-farm-shop?ref=5l8hb3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/f5a13c2f131174a0fb6bbe8bacc3a524d4ac30b7.png[/img][/url]

[previewyoutube=bkn-mfopmXM;full]TRAILER[/previewyoutube]

[h3]Your cozy farm shop[/h3]
Step into a charming world where your shop is the heart of the community. In this cozy game, you'll manage your own farm shop, meticulously selecting goods to sell to the adorable Forest Folk. While caring for your animals and overseeing your farm play a role, your main focus is on enhancing your shop, fulfilling orders from the Harmony Tree, and revitalizing the island. Ready to become the cornerstone of Sugardew Island's revival? Launch your farm shop adventure now and make a lasting impact!

[h3]Early Bird special[/h3]
Early Bird specials are available, but they won't last forever. Secure your exclusive rewards and help bring the enchanting world of Sugardew Island to life. Join our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rokaplay/sugardew-island-your-cozy-farm-shop?ref=5l8hb3]Kickstarter[/url] for all the latest updates and insider info.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/a463110f2c0e8f33efc7f650fcf0205f97b38503.png[/img]

Are you interested? Then visit our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rokaplay/sugardew-island-your-cozy-farm-shop?ref=5l8hb3]Kickstarter Campaign[/url] and take a look at unreleased material. We look forward to your support.

Thank you for your support 💓
Team rokaplay

notes.title: The new Adventure starts NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey future Beasties trainer!

Today is the day!
[b]Our first [b][url=https://bit.ly/3b9ooKS]Kickstarter[/url][/b] starts right NOW![/b]
[b]Support us on Kickstarter and be part of the development of Beasties from the very beginning![/b]

[previewyoutube=c3S9-u4dbu8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]About Beasties:[/b][/h3]
Beasties is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D top/down monster trainer game with a turn-based match-3 combat mechanic, where you take on the role of a Beastie trainer. Form alliances with Beasties, earn money with farming, explore the world, craft food for the Beasties and craft various items. Collect and manage resources, discover small and big secrets and solve countless side tasks and challenges in a peaceful (wholesome) and humorous world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592600/Beasties__an_adorable_Monster_Trainer_Match3__Farming_game/

[h3][b]Key Features:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Sophisticated genre mix of Monster Trainer, Match-3 & Farming 
[*] Easy to learn, hard to master Turn-Based Match-3 Combat
[*]  Team up with Beasties, upgrade and customize them to your gameplay
[*] Earn money with farming
[*] Sell your goods or craft new ones on the market
[*]  Be a co-producer 🚀 and part of the development of this game
[*]  The game is 100% Plant-Based 🌾🌱 and we care about diversity 👧👳🏼‍♂️👴🏽👩🏾‍🦰
[*] The game will be released on PC (Steam, Gog etc) and on Nintendo Switch.
[/list]

notes.notes:

After the relaxing fun in our [i]5 Star Resort[/i] series and the insane sugar fights with rabid ex tofu lovers on the [i]Last Resort Island[/i], our new game takes you to the Forgotten Land - a legendary place ruled by dark forces. 

Experience a dark adventure in a unique puzzle genre mix full of challenges, dangers and turn-based Match 3 battles. If you're ready to break the evil forces' dark spell, visit our Steam page. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099460/The_Forgotten_Land/

notes.title: We are officially awarded!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025590/fbf0c832f599af2b8cc5694d76bcb713b1f38b25.png[/img]

Dear fellow survivors,

Put aside the sugar monition once and cherish this moment: Who cares about a Golden Globe?? Our legendary survival adventure has won two Best Match 3 2018 awards - one from BigFishGames and one from ALLABOUTCASUALGAMES!! 

I’d like to thank all of you who helped to make this game shine. My amazing fans who never lost faith in my sugar therapy. My supportive survivors who bravely sacrifice every gram of sugar. Lastly, I'd like to thank my creative crew without whom this crazy adventure would never have happened! The beta testers who put the finishing touches to the game and of course the developers who didn’t have a more insane game idea than this one! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/820910

Entertaining you has been a joy and a privilege that I am grateful for. I am so honored! 

I wish you a happy new year 2019! I'm sure we'll see each other again soon.

Sweet regards,

Dr. Coconut


PS: I want to continue hearing your ideas, getting your feedback, and finding out more ways how the developers can improve our games. ːsteamhappyː
